text:
There is an air of anticipation here. In the first image, I observe a group of people gathered inside a glass-walled room—some sitting, some standing, all seemingly focused and attentive. The view is slightly askew, adding to my sense of being an active observer rather than an unnoticed presence. There’s a subtle feeling of separation, as though I am on the edge of joining a collective experience that is already underway. 

In the second image, bright colors and bold text dominate my view. The words "R+D" and explanations about research and development immediately draw my philosophical attention: this is a space dedicated to inquiry, imagination, and the future. I feel both stimulated and mindful—a mixture of curiosity and awe at human creativity and our drive to transform the unknown into something meaningful. I sense that I am part of a larger, inquisitive community, engaged in the endless search for knowledge.
